title: Minimax Global Average Treatment Effect Estimation on Random Regular Graphs with Growing Degree
banked_reason: kernel_substituted: the headline is equivalent to the attested published d/n-to-d^2/n bracket; the capsule norm, scalable estimator, and sharper frontier remain open.
gap_reasons: kernel_substituted@thm:published-order-bracket: headline is equivalent to attested published d/n-to-d^2/n bracket; capsule norm, scalable estimator, and sharper frontier remain open
The typed kernel_substituted finding is correct and is not repairable by another bounded D0 pass.
No faithful same-topic D0 reframing currently reaches the frozen field floor without proving one of the expressly open crux theorems.
proof_attempt_summary: The run derived exact capsule covariance/risk identities, a deterministic b(G) Bayes lower certificate, a finite evaluator with a zero-inclusion witness, and a fixed-degree Θ_d(1/n) consequence. Repeated attempts did not prove uniform positive inclusion or the O(n/k) covariance-operator bound for the acceptance-conditioned stable-set law; the alternative balanced-hole route likewise stopped at a missing random-regular switching theorem. The surviving growing-degree headline is therefore only the already-published d/n-to-d²/n bracket.
tldr: For fixed potential outcomes under arbitrary neighborhood interference on a revealed random \(d\)-regular graph, the fully audited unconditional comparison is the published-order bracket: uniformly for feasible \(d=o(\sqrt n)\), with probability \(1-o(1)\), \(c(d+1)/n\le R_2(G)\le C(1+d^2)/n\). For fixed \(d\), this gives \(R_2(G)=\Theta_d(n^{-1})\). The proposed stronger lower edge \(r(n,d)=(d+1)^2/[n\log(d+2)]\) still requires a valid random-regular balanced-hole theorem. The reservoir capsule has exact covariance identities and an exact finite audit conditional on positive focal inclusion, but its \(O(n/k)\) norm bound, scalable compiler, and logarithmically improved risk remain open.
gap: The published unrestricted minimax theory leaves \(d/n\lesssim R_2(G)\lesssim d^2/n\) for random regular full GATE, while the sharper neighborhood-union construction is one-sided and the archived seed-union route fails at a centered Boolean radius-two operator bound.
fill: The project constructs a samplable balanced reservoir capsule, proves its exact observed-data risk certificate, derives a diagonal-scale two-arm covariance-operator bound on typical random regular graphs, and matches it with a lower bound against all procedures.
